failure_modes.recovery: Ask a tenant admin or owner to approve.
failure_modes.when: the caller's role is below admin

failure_modes.recovery: Only submitted (pending) expenses can be approved.

preconditions: id is required. pending → approved (admin+); stamps approved_by/approved_at.

description: Approves a submitted expense claim — requires the admin or owner role, and only a 'pending' expense qualifies (CONFLICT otherwise). Stamps approved_by and approved_at with the caller and the current time; once approved, the row's content freezes for everyone except the approver themselves. NEXT: expense_reimburse (owner only) to pay it out.
name: expense_approve
